Subject: Runway adjustment request and strategy tradeoffs (mid-quarter OKR steer)

Team —

Quick mid-quarter status and a ask for an exec steer by EOD Tue 3-Nov. I kept this short and attached a simple impact model. TL;DR: our expected Q4 integration ramp with Acme has slid ~3 weeks and that creates a potential 18% gap against KR2 (paid integrations) unless we re-scope or accelerate other channels.

Where we are (high level):
- KR1 (latency SLO across hosted API): on-track, +3% margin over target due to infra tuning.
- KR2 (paid integrations: 3 new anchor customers): currently 1 signed (Acme), integrations target relies on Acme’s November go-live. Acme now signals a slip to late Nov.
- KR3 (unit-cost reduction): making progress but needs additional batching config work (infra dependency).

Options I recommend we consider (short):
A) Keep current scope and accept KR2 delta — surface to Execs, prioritize marketing push to close 1 more anchor customer (2 weeks).
B) Re-scope KR2 to "2 anchor customers + expansion MRR" and shift focus to conversion metrics for pipeline (preferred operationally).
C) Hold scope; provide dedicated infra burst (approx 4 GPU-weeks) to accelerate Acme integration and avoid slip — requires a procurement/infra exception.

Immediate asks:
1) Vanessa: please confirm preferred exec steer (A/B/C) by Tue EOD 3-Nov so I can align with Growth and Legal.
2) Markus: can infra estimate dedicated burst and quick canary plan? Mark that as high priority in your cluster queue.
3) Naomi: if we go with C, can CS/Eng sign an accelerated integration SLA doc with Acme? I will loop legal.

Attachments: runway-impact-model.xlsx (simple numbers), q4-okr-candidate-changes.pdf (patches for KR wording).

I put a short sheet in Drive (link below) with the revenue sensitivity matrix. Happy to discuss 15m tomorrow morning if helpful.

—Rafael

Rafael / Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick operational reality and one recommendation.

Operational notes:
- Dedicated burst: we can provide the 4 GPU-weeks as proposed, but we'd need a 72-hour lead to stage infra (image bake, capacity reservation, monitoring hooks). Cost estimate ~ $18k incremental.
- Canary plan: I sketched a 7-day canary (attached canary-plan.md) focusing on prefix cache warmup and staged KV cache warm starts. This limits blast radius for Acme integration cuts.
- Risk: if we do C without legal SLA concessions, we still might be blocked on data routing / KMS key handover in the final integration steps. Legal turnaround estimate: 5 business days.

Recommendation: present B to Execs with a fallback (C) if Execs are willing to approve the $18k infra burst + expedited legal review for SLA exceptions. That preserves our okr cadence while keeping an option to hit full scope if we want to commit budget.

I prioritized infra tickets and cc'd Priyom to help with cost/approval path.

Attachments: canary-plan.md

-Markus
